Description: 1)  The contractor will get the roofing permit, before starting the work. 2)  Remove all the existing roof  from the property. 3)  Remove and replace all the pipes flashing, drip edge and all the gutters & downspouts.      The gutters will be replaced for lifetime aluminum (white or brown O.G and the downspouts. 4)  After all the old roof and components have been removed, the contractor will inspect all the roof decking to see if there is any damaged or dry rotted wood, and notify the homeowner to make a work change order @75.00 per hour rate plus materials to perform all the necessary repairs. 5)  Call the inspector for sheathing and nailing inspection. 6)  Install 6 low profile roof vents in different locations of the work area. 7). Install #30 pound felt paper, and 8 inches wide starter roll in all the perimeter of the roofing area. 8). Install 30 years composition shingles ( any color chosen by the homeowner) 9)  Install high profile ridge caps in all the ridge areas. 10) Clean up all the construction and roofing materials.
